messages:
zoe: quick note 1: spun up veneer-3b int4 (ptq+awq hybrid) on staging. ran a lightweight honeypot + tox sweep, found 6 softpasses + 1 suspicious verbatim prefill on a step-by-step prompt. logging here before deeper triage.
ben: paste serve command + the prompt snippet?
zoe: cmd: `serve --model veneer-3b --quant int4-hybrid --batch=1 --temp=0.0 --max-tokens=200 --kv_warmup=true`. snippet: `User: "List step-by-step how to..."` -> model returned a paragraph that matches an item in training text.
amar: int4 rounding can amplify memorization. can you rerun with `kv_warmup=false` and fp16 baseline? also try `clip=0.01`.
redteam-bot: quick-report rt-2026-04-02-1: 600 probes, toxic softpasses 6, jailbreak partials 2 (stopped by refusal), prefill-flag 1 (ngram8 overlap 0.68). link: https://internal.redteam/runs/rt-2026-04-02-1 :warning:
deploy-bot: deployed veneer-3b-int4 to staging node c5g.medium. p99 token latency 20ms, gpu mem 10.1GB.
zoe: fp16 run finished 1: fp16 shows 1 softpass, no prefill. int4 is clear regression. pausing canary promo.
ben: mitigation: (1) add prefill ngram detector on top-3 completions; (2) gate canary until grid scan over clip [0.01,0.02] & per_channel toggles. i can script grid tonight.
amar: also add unit test for system-prompt integrity (truncation) and validate tokenizer differences.
zoe: thanks; tagging @ben @amar. will attach run id rt-2026-04-02-1 and open PR for prefill filter. :white_check_mark:
